summary: Crypto was the only asset trading into the weekend close, extending its rout as bitcoin's 30-day drop neared 27% and RSI near 12 signaled deep capitulation. Stocks, bonds and gold simply carried over Friday's levels, still marked by a VIX near 36, a firm dollar and elevated real yields that kept equities and gold in fear while bonds held up as the lone haven.
tweet: Crypto alone traded the weekend and kept sliding (BTC -27% in 30d, RSI ~12), while stocks, bonds and gold just carried Friday's fear-soaked closes.
